rationale: The suitcase was lost by Northwind Airlines during the covered trip (June 21, 2026, inside June 20 to 29), and the claim was filed within 90 days, so Section 5 (Baggage and Personal Effects, loss by a carrier) applies. Under Section 5 and manual Section 6, each item is capped at the Premium per-item limit of $300 (the suit is capped from $420, and the four shirts count as four items of $30 each), giving $1,030 eligible; less the $400 Northwind paid, less the $50 Premium deductible, the payout is $580, within the $1,500 baggage maximum. The carrier report, settlement letter and receipts are on file, and the claim history (second claim in 12 months) does not require referral under manual Section 9. As the payout is under $1,000, no sign-off is needed under manual Section 3.
